title: Earth Orientation Parameters
text: Calculate Earth orientation parameters (EOP), 1 input, 6 outputs, {Action for out-of-range input} sets Out-of-range block behavior; {IERS data file} sets the earth orientation data, {Output parameter error} enables output ports to return errors, {IERS data URL} sets the web site or Earth orientation data file and {Destination folder} sets the folder for IERS data file. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ΔUT1
ports.summary: Difference between UT1 and UTC scalar

ports.name: [dX,dY]
ports.summary: Adjustment to location of Celestial Intermediate Pole (CIP) vector

ports.name: ΔUT1 err
ports.summary: Return errors for the measured and predicted values in the IERS data vector

ports.name: [xp,yp] err
ports.summary: Return errors for the measured and predicted values in the IERS data vector

ports.name: [dX,dY] err
ports.summary: Return errors for the measured and predicted values in the IERS data vector

params.name: Output parameter error
params.values: Enable output ports to return errors off (default) | on

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range block behavior None (default) | Warning | Error

params.name: IERS data URL
params.values: Web site or Earth orientation data file http://maia.usno.navy.mil/ser7/finals2000A.data (default) | web site address | file name

params.name: Destination folder
params.values: Folder for IERS data file current Folder (default)
